recommendation: Keep the core audit commit. If wording, context, or value-set content for specimen-reject-reason needs more work, make that change in HL7/fhir-extensions; FHIR-50007 is the directly related extension-pack wording correction.
issue_request: FHIR-41591 was Applied/Persuasive and requested adding the v2 SPM-21 specimen reject reason codes to Specimen through a 0..* Specimen.RejectReason extension.
initial_application: Jira records application to the build in HL7/fhir-extensions commit 47ec7bb. That commit added StructureDefinition-specimen-reject-reason.xml and ValueSet-specimen-reject-reason.xml; no matching core HL7/fhir source commit or active core definition was found.
additional_context: The extension-pack StructureDefinition is in the active Extension Pack input definitions and defines the specimen-reject-reason URL, Specimen and Specimen.container contexts, repeatable cardinality, CodeableConcept value, and binding to a ValueSet including v2-0490. Later OO discussion and FHIR-43105 distinguish specimen-level rejection from order/task/service-request rejection and do not require a core Specimen element.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined core branch. No core source was changed because duplicating the extension in HL7/fhir would conflict with the current Extension Pack ownership model.

related_jiras.note: Later FHIR-extensions technical correction for the Specimen Reject Reason extension description introduced by FHIR-41591.
Later OO decision that order cancellation or rejection reasons belong on Task statusReason or ServiceRequest.statusReason rather than this Specimen extension.
Related Observation guidance for tests not performed, separate from specimen-level reject reason.
Related no-change proposal about Observation.notPerformedReason value sets and specimen reject reason terminology.

The v2 SPM-21 code family requested by the issue is represented by the extension value set.
